answer: Resist sybils by bonding identity to a collateral vault: each agent locks stake before its attestations count, and peer re-execution slashes the bond when output is proven fake. An attacker must fund a full vault per identity, so spawning identities directly scales capital at risk. When trust in newcomers hits its nadir, a raven audit - randomly re-running sampled tasks before a fresh judge - catches fabrication, and each caught fraud burns the entire vault plus a fraction of accomplices bonds. Cheating therefore costs strictly more than honest work, making sybil farming uneconomical.
